Research

At the Molecular Breeding Lab, Department of Plant Breeding and Genetics, Islamia University of Bahawalpur, I connect genome-wide computation, wet lab validation and field breeding across crops.

Gene families and evolution

Genome-wide identification and comparative genomics across plant lineages.

Fiber and stress biology

Fiber development and abiotic stress tolerance in crop plants.

Molecular breeding

Breeding approaches and GWAS for plant genetic improvement.

Field phenotyping

RCBD trials, DUS characterization and multivariate analysis of cotton lines.

Under review in JPGR

My BSc thesis work on the Kinesin-7 gene family, co-authored with Zhengzhou University and the National Cotton Breeding Institute, is now a manuscript under review. My MSc thesis, supervised by Dr. Abdul Rahman, characterizes ten stable cotton breeding lines under semi-arid conditions.
